lines.en: I stride across the ground.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨撞开一丛灌木
lines.en: My shoulder bone knocks a bush aside.

lines.zh: 我的每一步都带着怒气
lines.en: Every step carries my anger.
I crush the stones underfoot.
I swing my arms as I walk.
I push forward with my head low.
I step around a fallen trunk.
I walk heavily, and the ground rings.
I halt my stride and drop my shoulder.
I come out from under the trees.
I bear down on you, step by step.
I shuffle closer.
I stand, my bones creaking.

lines.zh: 我很生气，但不知道生谁的气
lines.en: I am angry and do not know at whom.
My fingers stay spread.
There is nothing here to smash.
I hold still and seethe.
I lift my head, then lower it.
There is nothing in my chest.
I wait for someone.
I bite at nothing and my jaw clacks.
I roll my shoulders.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气让我更生气
lines.en: Your warmth makes me angrier.
I stare at you, bones creaking.
You are a size smaller than me.
When I raise my hand, you should run.
I do not like living things.
You stand rather firmly.
I lower my head to look at you.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨头比你的护甲重
lines.en: My bones weigh more than your armour.
What is it you are laughing at?
I edge one step closer.

lines.zh: 我的一根臂骨折了半截
lines.en: One of my arm bones snapped in half.
My heels give half a pace.
That only makes me angrier.
My frame is knocked crooked.
I straighten my own ribs.
I clench my jaw hard.
I have not lain down yet.
I am putting that on the account.
My arms hang heavier.
These two arms can still smash.
No tongue in my skull, so nothing tastes.
Take that thing away.
That only annoys me more.
I only want to smash.

lines.zh: 举那玩意儿给我看干嘛
lines.en: Why show me that thing?
I have no stomach, only anger.
I swat at it.
You keep that little thing.
I shake my head, and bones rattle.
Wave it again and I flatten it.

lines.zh: 你撞在我最硬的一排肋骨
lines.en: You hit the hardest row of my ribs.
This frame of mine does not budge.
You are knocked flying.
My bare bone scrapes you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了我的趾骨
lines.en: Your boot crushed one of my toe bones.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我吼了一声
lines.en: We collide, and I roar.

lines.zh: 我抬手把你的肩膀拨开
lines.en: I lift a hand and shove your shoulder aside.
That should move you.
My frame sways.
I step back to my place.

lines.zh: 我生气的时候不想这些
lines.en: I do not think of such things when angry.
I am only bones and anger.
Do not ask about that again.
I want no one.
I twist away and go.
There is only me here.
I pound my fist on a tree.
This only irritates me more.
I let out a low roar.
I start walking again.
I grab it and smash it.

lines.zh: 这点分量压不住我手心
lines.en: This weight barely settles in my palm.

lines.zh: 我的指骨一收，它就碎了
lines.en: My fingers close once and it shatters.
I hurl it aside.

lines.zh: 它从我的骨头缝里掉了
lines.en: It falls through my fingers.
Whoever dropped it, I smash it.
I grind it into the mud under my heel.
This is of no use whatsoever.
I hold it, look, then drop it.
It is of no use to me.
I never let anyone block my path.
I raise my head and see you.
At last, something to smash.
I swing my long legs into a stride toward you.
You are on my list.

lines.zh: 我从胸腔里挤出一声吼
lines.en: I squeeze a roar out of this hollow chest.
My arms go overhead.
Do not run; it only annoys me more.
Your warmth is reason enough.
I am already moving.
I am angry; you had better move.
I crack the paving stone under my foot.

lines.zh: 我把怒气全压进这一拳
lines.en: I stuff all my rage into this one fist.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里只装得下你
lines.en: My eye sockets have room for nothing but you.
I start counting at one.

lines.zh: 我这一身怒气找到你了
lines.en: All this rage of mine has finally found you.
That skeleton of yours is mine now.
The ground shudders with every step I take.
My finger bones grind as they clench.
You retreat, I follow.
I do not tire, and I will not stop.
My anger grows heavier.
You are shuffling backwards.

lines.zh: 我一边压过去一边数你的步子
lines.en: I bear down and count your steps.
This tree is in my way.
I break it in half.
I smash my way over.

lines.zh: 我的脚骨碾碎了脚下的砖
lines.en: My foot bones grind the bricks beneath me.
Run, and I'll knock the trees aside.
I edge nearer.
All my bones are creaking.
My steps leave dents in the ground.
I've backed you against the stone wall.
Both my arms are up.
I do not intend to be reasonable.
You will not stay standing.
I count to three, then I swing.
I bring both arms down.
The ground cracks under it.
You are knocked clear.
My bones are harder than stone.
I follow with another fist.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，手却抬不起来
lines.en: You blocked it, but could not lift your arms after.
I swing, roaring.
You are thrown a long way.

lines.zh: 我把半边身子砸了下去
lines.en: I bring half my frame down with the blow.
My forearm has come loose.

lines.zh: 你身上有骨头断的声音
lines.en: Something in you cracked.

lines.zh: 我抡圆了手臂横扫过去
lines.en: I wind my arm up and sweep it across.
I have flattened this place.
I pant, though I need not.
I have not hit the ground.
Now there is something to it.

lines.zh: 泥土从我的肋骨间落下
lines.en: Dirt sifts down between my ribs.

lines.zh: 一堆骨头慢慢拼成了我
lines.en: A heap of bones assembles into me.
I lift my skull.
This soil is fresh.
When I am angry, my bones grow heavier.
I shake the mud off.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条手臂，试了试
lines.en: I raise one arm and test it.
I step out of the black shadow.
I swat down what is in front of me.
I have seen something alive.

lines.zh: 我的怒气从一睁眼就有了
lines.en: My anger was there before my eyes opened.
I cave in a patch of ground.
I straighten my spine one joint at a time.
My fingers spread, bone by bone.
Fire blackens my bones.
I fall and lose half my frame.
Water floods my chest.
The blast flips me over entirely.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder bone.
Magic rolls through my bones.
I stopped living by eating long ago.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的骨头都白了
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my bones go white.

lines.zh: 我脚底下的地一下没了
lines.en: The ground under my feet is gone.
